name: Harbin Removals
description: Home and office removals company in the fictional town of Lowther Bay.

items.title: Removal price guide
items.content: A two-bedroom local move costs about $1,180 with a crew of 3; packing materials add $145. Guide HR-PRC-2.

items.title: Storage unit sizes
items.content: Units range from 35 to 260 square feet; climate-controlled units cost $9 a week extra. Brochure HR-STO-5.

items.title: Lifting technique briefing
items.content: Crews use the two-person lift for anything over 23 kg; pianos need the stair-climber, key held by Duncan Fyfe. Briefing HR-LFT-44.

items.title: Crew tips policy
items.content: Cash tips are pooled and split weekly; card tips are added to payroll on the 19th. Policy HR-TIP-3.

items.title: Van lease renewal
items.content: Six Luton vans are leased from Northway Vehicle Hire at $612 a month each until 2027-05-31. Lease HR-VAN-0531.

items.title: Customer damage claim
items.content: Customer Priya Lanchester claims $18,600 for a cabinet broken on 2026-09-08; our insurer, Stonebridge Mutual, disputes $11,000 of it. Claim HR-CLM-0908-L.
